test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bite the bullet

options.text: To help someone achieve their goals

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Bite the bullet"** means to endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is seen as unavoidable. (कठिन स्थिति का सामना करना) • **Example:** Even though he didn't want to, he had to **bite the bulle**t and go to the dentist. • **"Face a difficult situation"** means to confront or deal with a challenging or adverse circumstance. (कठिन परिस्थिति का सामना करना) • **Example:** She had to** face a difficult situation **when she lost her job unexpectedly. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To avoid a situation** (स्थिति से बचना): To stay away from or try not to engage in a particular circumstance. • **Example:** He tends to avoid any situation where he might have to speak in public. • **To help someone achieve their goals** (किसी को उसके लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने में मदद करना): To assist someone in reaching their objectives. • **Example:** The mentor's role is to help students achieve their goals. • **To eat something unpleasant** (कुछ अप्रिय खाना): To consume food that is not tasty or enjoyable. • **Example:** He had to eat something unpleasant for the sake of his health. 2fc:Tbb4, The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
